title: IncidentForge Diagnosis
description: Structured output from the AI investigator. Unknown root_cause_ids, nonexistent evidence_ids, unapproved actions, and invalid target_refs make this INVALID.

root_cause_id.description: Must be in scenario's allowed_root_cause_ids, or the special value UNKNOWN.

summary.description: Human-readable explanation of the diagnosed root cause.

confidence.description: Model's self-reported confidence [0,1]. NOT a calibrated probability.

evidence_ids.description: IDs of evidence items cited. Must reference real run-scoped evidence IDs.

alternatives.description: Alternative hypotheses considered and ruled out.

remediation.description: Proposed typed remediation. null if the agent cannot propose a safe fix.

limitations.description: Optional: what evidence was unavailable or what uncertainty remains.
